title: After dozens of flights, broadcasters across Europe get bomb threats - what's going on
content: Recent bomb threats targeting passenger aircraft have sparked panic across Europe, causing significant disruptions in air travel and affecting media outlets. Several flights have been escorted by military jets as precautionary measures in response to looming security risks. Authorities are investigating connections to extremist groups while assessing whether geopolitical motives play a role in these operations, which appear to aim at fostering widespread anxiety.

title: PM Modi's Sule message; 'tussle' in NCP: Is Maha politics heading for another churn?
content: Internal conflicts within the Pawar clan has once again put the party at a crossroads. A meeting of senior NCP leaders with Union home minister Amit Shah amid reports of discontent within the party has fuelled speculations. NCP chief Sunetra Pawar has convened meetings to address unity concerns after Ajit Pawar's death. Rohit Pawar has issued a caution to the family regaridng possible BJP manoeuvres.

title: Louisiana woman's lawsuit over uncle's sale of 300-acre inheritance revived
content: A Louisiana woman accused her uncle of transferring interests in nearly 300 acres of her late mother's estate to himself and businesses linked to him. More than 23 years after her mother's death, an appeals court revived her claims concerning his handling of the estate but upheld the dismissal of other claims. It also cancelled a $10,000 damages award and ordered further proceedings.

title: ‘Thank you, Test Cricket’: Shami retires from longest format of the game
content: Mohammed Shami announced his retirement from Test cricket on Friday, exactly 13 years after making his debut against West Indies in 2013. The 36-year-old fast bowler signed off with 229 wickets from 64 Tests, including six five-wicket hauls. Shami last played a Test in June 2023 against Australia, sharing an emotional farewell message on Instagram.

title: 280 Ice Age engravings found in Spanish cave overlooked for 60 years
content: A remarkable archaeological find at Cova de la Font Major has revealed 280 Palaeolithic engravings, showcasing diverse motifs of animals and geometric shapes. This challenges the previously held notion that cave art was scarce in northeastern Iberia, where only two pieces were known. These engravings suggest the existence of unique artistic traditions independent of the famous Franco-Cantabrian region, offering new insights into the cultural practices of Ice Age Europe.

title: Black grouse chicks hatch in North York Moors after nearly 200-year absence
content: In a remarkable conservation achievement, black grouse have successfully hatched chicks in North York Moors after a long absence of 200 years. In 2024, 20 black grouse were moved from North Pennines as part of a dedicated effort that includes habitat restoration and management of predators. Reports indicate a notable rise in the number of displaying males, with plans for further translocations underway to bolster their population even more.

title: Elon Musk: Tesla to end Texas Cybertruck production to make way for Cybercab
content: Elon Musk announced that Tesla will reduce Cybertruck production around mid-2027 to increase Cybercab output. Sales of the Cybertruck have been significantly below initial forecasts, prompting this decision. The Cybertruck faced multiple recalls and price adjustments since its launch in late 2023. Regulatory scrutiny is ongoing for the Cybercab, Tesla's centerpiece in its autonomous vehicle strategy. Despite the wind-down, Musk maintains that the Cybertruck was a remarkable technological achievement.

This victory marked the team's sixth straight win of the season, highlighted by Stephen Curry's 29-point performance and Klay Thompson's emotional comeback.

title: Patrick Mahomes’ $8 million Missouri estate: Inside his eight-acre luxury compound
content: Patrick Mahomes moved his family into a custom estate in Belton, Missouri, in 2023. He purchased the land for $400,000 in September 2020 and began construction shortly afterward. The estate includes a private football field, a pool, and a gym designed for family use. Mahomes has a Texas home for the off-season, but Belton serves as the family's base during football season.

title: Fears Starlink, builds one of its own: Russia rushes to scale up Rassvet
content: Russia's Security Council has called for the rapid expansion of its satellite communications network, Rassvet, to counteract Starlink. The country has launched 32 satellites this year to support military communications in Ukraine. The network currently struggles with limited coverage and intermittent service over specific areas. Russian officials have highlighted security risks posed by Western satellite services operating over sovereign territories.

title: Olympics once awarded medals for poetry; 1912 gold went to founder under 2 fake names
content: The Olympic Games once awarded gold medals for poetry, music, architecture, painting and sculpture alongside traditional sporting events. Introduced at Pierre de Coubertin’s insistence in 1912, the artistic competitions even saw the Olympic founder secretly win a literature gold medal under two assumed names. However, amateurism rules and declining interest eventually brought the unusual tradition to an end after the 1948 London Olympics.

title: London council rejects 1,060-home plan after affordable housing cut to 12%
content: Southwark Council's planning committee voted unanimously against Berkeley Homes' revised plans for the Bermondsey Place development. The housebuilder proposed reducing affordable housing from 40 percent to just 12 percent, causing strong local opposition. Council members expressed concerns about the long timeline for home completion and questioned the developer's financial figures. Berkeley Homes highlighted rising costs and council fees as reasons for the reduced affordable housing offer.

title: Mbappe's Mao remarks: Real Madrid, LaLiga face growing pressure despite apology
content: Kylian Mbappe's comments referencing Mao Zedong have stirred considerable controversy in China, jeopardising his sponsorship ties. This prompted Real Madrid and LaLiga to extend apologies to the Chinese community. Consequently, Chinese businesses have severed connections with Mbappe and put a hold on LaLiga broadcasts. Talks continue between Chinese officials and Spanish football organisations to foster clarity.

title: India's 20-year-old chess GM Pranav crowned World Jr Blitz champion
content: Indian Grandmaster Pranav Venkatesh won the Open title at the FIDE World Junior Blitz Championship in Al Ain, UAE, scoring 10.5 points from 13 rounds. The 20-year-old finished a point clear of his closest rivals, adding blitz gold to the rapid silver he won earlier. India’s Aamuktha Guntaka finished fifth in the Girls section, while Savitha Shri placed seventh.

title: 'Domestic feud, humiliation, resentment': What led B'luru man to kill 7 of wife's kin
content: Indushekar allegedly killed his wife, mother-in-law, and five relatives in Bengaluru due to domestic strife. After the initial murder, he reportedly invited his brothers-in-law and later killed them with the same weapon. The bodies are believed to have been hidden in different locations around the city. Investigators are currently exploring whether he acted alone or had assistance. Search operations for the remaining victims continue amidst ongoing police investigations.

title: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's meteoric rise continues as Bihar hand him captaincy at 15

The Bihar Cricket Association revealed the squad for the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy, featuring 17 players, with Suraj Kashyap as vice-captain. The team's journey kicks off on November 14, following Sooryavanshi's standout performances in both the Indian Premier League and international T20 cricket.

title: CBSE Class 10, 12 Board Exams 2027 datesheet released; exams begin February 16

More than 45 lakh students have registered for the examinations across 204 subjects. All papers will begin at 10:30 am. The board said it considered major entrance examination schedules while preparing the timetable.

title: Rs 29.57L cr added to investor wealth! Why Sensex, Nifty had best week in over 5 years

This positive shift was driven by a hefty influx from foreign institutional investors, who recorded their highest single-day purchases in the last six years. Additionally, lower crude oil rates and a strengthened rupee enhanced market confidence.

title: Nasa unveils X-70 Fractal, a flying lab to test future aircraft technology
content: Nasa has unveiled the X-70 Fractal, a cutting-edge experimental aircraft designed to test innovative flight-control technologies. This aircraft is set to revolutionize aircraft maneuverability while enhancing performance, capable of carrying a 2,000-pound payload. With its maiden flight anticipated in the next two years, Nasa aims to assess new aviation concepts under real-world conditions, thereby improving future civilian and military aircraft capabilities.
